name: Amari McCoy
bio: Ethiopian born and California raised, Amari McCoy's acting career began in print and commercials when she was just eighteen months old.

credits.title: Hot Wheels Let's Race: Attack of the T-Rex
credits.overview: When a giant T-Rex threatens Hot Wheels City, it's up to Coop and his friends to race to the rescue and save the day.

credits.title: The Good Boy Report
credits.overview: A young girl named Bunny hosts, edits and narrates a hard-hitting journalistic exposé about all the dogs in her neighborhood.

credits.title: Toy Story 5
credits.overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

credits.title: Dr. Seuss's The Sneetches
credits.overview: An unexpected friendship forms between two young Sneetches on an island surrounded by beaches in this sweet musical special set in the world of Seuss.

credits.title: Sneaks
credits.overview: When his sister is stolen by a shady collector, a pampered, custom sneaker must leave his velvet-lined box and navigate the streets of New York City with a ragtag group of streetwise footwear to bring her home.

credits.title: I (Un)Do
credits.overview: A new comedy about an unhappily married millennial couple finally agreeing about something, getting a divorce. There's just one problem: they can't afford it.

credits.title: Minions: The Rise of Gru
credits.overview: A fanboy of a supervillain supergroup known as the Vicious 6, Gru hatches a plan to become evil enough to join them, with the backup of his followers, the Minions.

credits.title: Fearless
credits.overview: A teen gamer is forced to level up to full-time babysitter when his favorite video game drops three superpowered infants from space into his backyard.
